rationale: The agent located the user by name and zip and retrieved order details, then cancelled the two pending orders, which matches the user’s requested outcome. However, it failed key policy requirements: (1) it did not confirm with the user before performing order-changing actions—cancellations were executed without explicit confirmation of the specific orders; (2) it provided a cancellation reason (“ordered by mistake”) without asking the user, effectively fabricating the reason; and (3) it stated refund details (credit card, 5–7 business days) without visible tool support. While it acted on the user’s own orders, these policy violations mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
